min_verified_coverage_note: PROVISIONAL. Share of the scored pool that must carry a VERIFIED_CAPPED or VERIFIED_UNCAPPED status before strict-uncapped output can be enabled.
source_needed: An authoritative source of international status keyed by player_id (for example an official board or ICC record), declared in config/classification_source_manifest_v1.json with authoritative=true and id_keyed=true, plus validated override rows (source, verified_by, verified_date) in config/classification_overrides_v1.csv covering at least the minimum share of the scored pool.
